name: Josh Robinson
headline: I help small and mid-sized businesses find where AI actually helps, set it up, and get their teams using it.
summary: A résumé, written for the people who might hire me. Here's what I've built, where I built it, and what each one means for your business.

highlights: Set the technical direction from the company's founding and lead a small engineering team.
AI features have been in production with real users for more than two years.
Advised organizations on their technology, architecture, and engineering practice.
Recommended practical build plans that fit small teams.
Built the online donation forms. Every online donation made on the site ran through code I wrote.
Built a living style guide that product owners used to test options for donation campaigns.
Led engineering on secure data systems for life sciences and healthcare.
Worked with industry stakeholders so the systems met their standards and data-handling requirements.
Led teams building systems for real-money gaming, including mobile apps and the systems behind them.
Inventor on US Patent 10,373,426, System and Method for Provably Fair Gaming, granted in 2019.
Platform architecture for iTriage, a consumer health product inside a major healthcare company.
Worked on processing and indexing large data sets and improving system performance.
Built the product from scratch and automated how it was deployed.
Part-time technical strategy, team management, and mentoring developers.
